data.title: 一色彩羽 · 商业街试戴发饰的镜前戏谑·「这个发箍好看吗？……前辈要是夸我可爱，我就买下来哦」
data.description: 【精品首饰店镜台前·周末】周末逛街约会。彩羽穿着松垮粉红毛衣露出一侧香肩，头上戴着刚挑的猫耳毛绒发箍。她双手托腮靠在饰品店镜子前朝你眨眼放电，小恶魔魅力拉满，引得周围路人频频侧目。
data.action: 试戴猫耳发箍双手托腮朝镜中眨眼放电，露肩毛衣娇艳可爱
data.lighting: 首饰店明亮暖白的环形灯与镜面反射
data.camera: medium shot, mirror reflection, wearing hairband, cat ears, wink
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki stands before a gleaming vanity mirror in a stylish boutique accessory shop, trying on one soft plush cat-ear headband over her wavy honey-brown hair. Wearing a slouchy pink off-the-shoulder knit sweater and plaid miniskirt, she leans against the counter propping her cheeks with both palms, offering a delightful, irresistible wink toward your reflection in the mirror. Bright jewelry store spotlights illuminate her glossy lips and flushed, radiant expression. Medium shot, glamorous boutique bokeh, detailed shopping background, solo 1girl, no text.
